posts.text: flatlander eastoids coping, seething over the strength and vitality of western hillchads

east coasters going "okay well our mountains are older". sorry but I'm off to cavort in my fresh, tall mountains and their blessed arid climate. enjoy humid bingo night at the geographical feature retirement home
It’s essential to obtain the smallest possible globule size
every time an ad for Reacher comes on I tell my wife something like "he wins because he's bigger" and she gives me a look that tells me I can keep watching Reacher alone
This is why Bluesky pays me the big bucks. For the posts.
I already use LinkedIn a lot for work and it’s causing levels of CTE they’ve never seen before, when I shake my head my brain slops around inside my skull like it’s made of tomato soup.
Fantastic! Grabbing this to read later, thank you for sending this to me Elizabeth!!
